components.css: .ds-form-group{margin:0;padding:32px 0 0;border:0;border-top:1px solid #343638;color:#efece5}.ds-form-group legend{padding:0 16px 0 0;background:#090a0b;color:#efece5;font:400 24px/1.2 var(--font-bodoni),Didot,serif}.ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:20px;color:#efece5;font:500 14px/1.4 var(--font-instrument),Arial,sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:48px;width:100%;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid #666862;border-radius:4px;background:#efece5;color:#090a0b;font:400 16px/1.5 var(--font-instrument),Arial,sans-serif;transition:border-color 200ms ease-out}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#62635f}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#9f9d96}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #efece5;outline-offset:4px;border-color:#fff}.ds-field input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:#c49098}.ds-field-error{color:#dcaeb5;font:400 14px/1.5 var(--font-instrument),Arial,sans-serif}

components.css: .ds-diagnostic{border-bottom:1px solid #9f9d96;color:#090a0b}.ds-diagnostic button{min-height:96px;width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr 44px;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:20px 0;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;text-align:left}.ds-diagnostic button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #090a0b;outline-offset:4px}.ds-diagnostic-number{color:#6a3038;font:400 12px/1.4 var(--font-instrument),Arial,sans-serif}.ds-diagnostic strong{font:400 clamp(30px,4vw,36px)/1.05 var(--font-bodoni),Didot,serif}.ds-diagnostic-toggle{width:44px;height:44px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #9f9d96;border-radius:9999px;font:400 20px/1 var(--font-instrument),Arial,sans-serif;transition:transform 300ms ease-out,background-color 200ms ease-out,color 200ms ease-out}.ds-diagnostic button:hover .ds-diagnostic-toggle{background:#090a0b;color:#fff}.ds-diagnostic button[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-diagnostic-toggle{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-diagnostic p{max-width:64ch;margin:0;padding:0 56px 24px 48px;color:#565650;font:400 14px/1.7 var(--font-instrument),Arial,sans-serif}

components.css: .ds-expertise{border-bottom:1px solid #343638;color:#efece5}.ds-expertise summary{min-height:96px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px 1fr 24px;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:20px 0;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-expertise summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-expertise summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #efece5;outline-offset:4px}.ds-expertise span{color:#8d8e8b;font:400 12px/1.4 var(--font-instrument),Arial,sans-serif}.ds-expertise strong{font:400 clamp(32px,5vw,70px)/1 var(--font-bodoni),Didot,serif;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:color 300ms ease-out}.ds-expertise i{font:400 24px/1 var(--font-instrument),Arial,sans-serif;transition:transform 300ms ease-out}.ds-expertise[open] strong{color:#c49098}.ds-expertise[open] i{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-expertise p{max-width:36rem;margin:0 0 32px auto;color:#a4a5a3;font:400 16px/1.75 var(--font-instrument),Arial,sans-serif}

components.css: .ds-journey{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:16px;color:#efece5}.ds-journey span{font:400 clamp(24px,3vw,36px)/1 var(--font-bodoni),Didot,serif;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-journey i{height:1px;background:#6a3038;transform-origin:left;animation:ds-line-draw 800ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}@keyframes ds-line-draw{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-journey{grid-template-columns:1fr;justify-items:center}.ds-journey i{width:1px;height:40px;transform-origin:top;animation-name:ds-line-draw-mobile}@keyframes ds-line-draw-mobile{from{transform:scaleY(0)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-journey i{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Jurivo Black Label is the selected, canonical visual world. It turns the atmosphere of a sophisticated Johannesburg office at blue hour into a serious professional-services system: carbon darkness, warm paper, precise rules, controlled wine, and editorial serif scale. The feeling is commanding and memorable without drifting into luxury theatre.

The page moves through dark and light fields in a deliberate rhythm. Cinematic imagery establishes authority once; typography and evidence-led structure carry the rest. The visual system rejects generic agency gradients, legal clichés, gold, fake proof, and feature-card scaffolds.
keyCharacteristics: Cinematic carbon hero followed by alternating warm-paper and dark sections.
Bodoni Moda creates drama; Instrument Sans keeps controls and body copy direct.
Thin rules and tonal shifts provide structure instead of shadows or ornamental chrome.
Wine appears only in connections, selected states, and decisive typographic moments.
Motion is slow, linear, and architectural: image drift, line drawing, and controlled disclosure.

rules.name: The No Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold turns cinematic authority into a luxury cliché; it is never part of Jurivo.

rules.name: The Wine Rarity Rule
rules.body: Wine should remain a deliberate signal, not a large surface or general decoration.

rules.name: The Statement Rule
rules.body: Headings state the commercial idea directly; they do not require a pre-heading label to explain their purpose.

rules.name: The Flat Authority Rule
rules.body: Content sections do not use card shadows; a thin rule or a surface change is enough.

dos: Do alternate carbon, warm paper, and charcoal to maintain the signature rhythm.
Do let typography and one decisive image carry the atmosphere.
Do keep interactions fully operable by keyboard and touch.
Do use South African English and explicit law-firm commercial language.
Do label illustrative diagnostics and avoid invented performance proof.
donts: Don't add gold, neon, gradients, glass cards, or glow effects.
Don't use gavels, scales, handshakes, courtrooms, or staged lawyers.
Don't turn the page into an uninterrupted dark site; the paper transitions are essential.
Don't use rounded SaaS cards or icon-feature grids as primary structure.
Don't add repeated eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't fabricate clients, testimonials, case studies, or growth statistics.
